{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the meaning of -1 in customer_age
# Filter for records where customer_age == -1
age_neg1_count = (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()

# Check how many records have a valid age (not -1 and not null)
valid_age_count = (sales_df['customer_age'] != -1).sum()

# Compute mean age excluding -1 values
mean_age_excluding_neg1 = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

age_neg1_count, valid_age_count, mean_age_excluding_neg1"}
